focus: The bar has one tab stop (roving tabindex follows focus). Opening a menu moves real DOM focus to its first (or last) enabled item; activation, Escape at the top level, Tab, and close() with focus inside return focus to the bar item. Bar items show color-hover while hovered or expanded and a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible.
notes: Disabled items stay focusable, per the APG, so screen-reader users discover them.
Hovering another bar item while a menu is open switches menus (pointer movement only; touch never switches).
Each menu level is a separate overlay-stack entry, so Escape and outside presses close the topmost level first, including inside a Dialog.
aui-select ids never collide: ids are validated as unique across the bar and all menus.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
A global configuration change or update() while a menu is open closes it without restoring focus to the bar item.
